source_semantic_controls: Positive purebred, herdbook, approved-program, regular-use, female-mating, Austrian-location and applicant-activity gates are actual improvements. Exact breed/category/species binding and guarded nullable fields are preserved.

The April replacement-stallion comparison isolates the local age condition at actual replacement. The January replacement control isolates the actual approval-year exception from the prior funding-year value.
A third timely eligible successor is a source-coverage limit of the disclosed A13 implementation, with a positive two-successor control. It is not a claim that source law limits chains to two.
A completed pre-participation absence must not become a current holding/measure-reporting violation. Independent animal-identification duties remain separate.

The mare case is explicitly a completed annual observation with a passed 42-month deadline, not an open-future prediction. It diagnoses local follow-up coverage. A conflicting comprehensive confirmed status requires evidence reconciliation and does not prove an unlawful actual award.

Replacement date before claimed first actual arrival is input-consistency stress. Earlier real arrival followed by later slot assumption is valid and positively controlled; no equality of the two dates is required.

Tariff/GEP controls stipulate actual annual programme implementation and all other eligibility evidence. Conditional AnnexD obligations do not become universal false gates because detailed fields are absent.
Programme-period and future-deregistration controls use the supplied SRL 5 period, not an imported GSP oracle. Late reports remain procedural findings without an invented automatic full reduction.

Regular slot eligibility, replacement-row base eligibility and whole-applicant access/payout are different scopes. The four root controls retain correct known zero payments when the original slot or initial application fails.

Sow sequence versus aggregate share, extension of the minimum-premium convention to every replacement direction, effects of missing prior reporting, the August 31 replacement-report boundary and the replacement-correction UELN field remain disclosed interpretations.
The short-stay controls follow disclosed A16 elapsed-date subtraction. They do not conclusively settle inclusive endpoint counting without times. The source names ten calendar days.

The eG/eGen organisation suffix difference follows the authoritative annex and is not a model error. Actual responsible-organisation evidence, authority approval and complete payment stages remain external.

runtime_errors_outside_schema.scope: These are explicitly invalid-date schema stresses. Safe diagnostic expectations are engineering requirements, not legal OPA-status oracles.
